resources.string: Calibrate horizontal area

Sit normally while parked. Keep the whole square comfortably visible with small head movements. Set left using its left edge, then set right using its right edge. Save applies both limits to the HUD camera panel, labels and arrow. Existing position and trim still control factory-graphic clearance; vertical visibility is unchanged.
No calibration saved. Normal HUD placement is used until you set both boundaries and save.
